Button.summary: Base button control that tracks the pressed state and repaints; the visual itself is supplied by the skin/theme

props.caption: Button caption text, default 'button'
props.noFont: Skip automatic creation of the default font object, default false
props.alignPadding: Alignment padding factor (ratio, default 0.5) used by the theme to inset the text

Button:SetCaption.desc: Set the caption text and trigger Invalidate when it actually changed

Button:DrawControl.desc: Draw the button; this is an empty stub, the skin/theme overrides it

Button:HitTest.desc: Hit test that always returns self, so the whole rectangle is clickable

Button:MouseDown.desc: Set state.pressed=true, call the inherited MouseDown, Invalidate and return self

Button:MouseUp.desc: Only when state.pressed: clear the pressed state, call the inherited MouseUp, Invalidate and return self

fileDesc: Defines the Button base class: tracks the pressed state and repaints, while the look is supplied by the skin/theme.
